modules.name: SAA-linked tactical decision workbench
modules.purpose: Freezes SAA class budgets and group constraints from real local configuration, reads strict common NAV intervals, compares causal momentum/manual/published-regime tilts using one TAA numerical core, selects strengths on mature training returns only, validates on a separate holdout, compares explicit shocks or historical replay and saves immutable decisions with frozen inputs. Shared application gates and server-owned product mappings preserve budgets in portfolio research. Research-only provenance never certifies historical deployment or formal PIT. Preflight reports common coverage, training/holdout counts, immature and unknown knowledge dates, and NAV scale findings; suggested date boundaries use clocks only and fixed-hypothesis comparison is explicit. Named scenario inputs are recomputed on save and restored with immutable decisions. Momentum algorithm available-window-relative-momentum/2.0.0 uses the latest contiguous complete window whose endpoints are known by each decision cutoff; unknown and expired windows cannot emit a signal, and preflight reports effective training/holdout signal counts and blocks strength selection when training has none.

modules.name: Published sensitivity models and reusable scenario impacts
modules.purpose: Separates product risk research from scenario transmission research while sharing typed variables and fixed-signature numerical kernels. OLS coefficients are estimated with independent chronological holdout validation, optional post-validation refit and explicit conditional-not-causal semantics. Fixed positive cashflows provide duration, convexity and single-step full repricing. Model, cashflow, transmission and scenario previews are transient and must not persist artifacts. Only explicit user confirmation of publication may write immutable runs, frozen arrays, scenario paths and release records to the guarded managed data disk, after recomputation and preview-hash verification. Product, portfolio, SAA and TAA consumers read published snapshots without training; portfolio inputs come from saved end holdings, not class-name guesses. Their stress-impact calculations are transient and are not newly persisted; old impact IDs remain read-only compatibility only. Original simulation methods remain real advanced experiments with their existing contracts.
out_of_scope_dependencies: identified structural macro causality or calibrated SVAR/BVAR

modules.name: Typed indicator primitives, shared DAG and fixed-signature NJIT runtime
modules.purpose: Typed DSL preserves nominal axes, bool masks, semantic dimensions and price-basis checks. Current authoring supports rolling_apply as a deferred complete interval-scalar subgraph: eligibility follows typed dependencies and reviewed primitive interval policies, not an indicator allowlist. A prepared NJIT loop binds aligned slice views, resets path/context state per window and collects numeric scalar results without materializing T×W data or compiling during evaluation. Scope implementation version participates in plan identity. Price/return date axes preserve existing missing observations, and return-only scopes do not discard the first supplied valid return; an extra preceding observation is requested only when level paths or elapsed-period context require it. Existing 2.3 rolling_* and 2.4 rolling_window-plus-reducer formulas retain their frozen contracts; newly derived whole-graph definitions use transform protocol 3.0.0. All five built-in time-series indicators now select revision 3 and use whole-interval scopes; explicit revision 1/2 references retain their original definitions. BOLL shares two scopes across three channels. KDJ uses optional minimum observations of 1 with finite_mask and conditional extrema, while its K/D recursion remains outside the scopes. Optional minimum-count scopes preserve raw date positions and delegate missing-value handling to the body; omitted minimum retains the complete-window contract. Generic execution costs the sum of interval computations, not guaranteed O(T), and is measurably slower than the historical specialized kernels for these small built-ins. Current formulas use mathematical and state primitives; supported historical business function spellings lower into the same current DAG rather than alternate production algorithms. Independent scalar metrics merge structurally identical nodes under matching bindings, versions and windows; selected roots prune unrelated branches. Drawdown dates share the last equally deepest interval and regression projections share a fitted state. Startup/save/explicit preparation owns fixed-signature NJIT compilation; formal evaluation fails closed without Python fallback or new signatures. Ordinary time-series multi-channel contracts remain separate from removed scalar bundles.

Empty classifications and tampered lineage are rejected; stored optional default_mode is omitted from legacy serialization and does not alter old definition hashes.

minimum_regression: /bin/sh -c 'cd frontend && npm run test -- --run src/pages/PortfolioConstruction.test.tsx src/pages/HoldingDiagnosis.test.tsx src/components/HistoricalRegimeBacktest.test.tsx src/services/portfolioResearch.test.ts'

modules.name: Manual ETF/public-fund construction, class allocation, strategy, and backtest UI
modules.purpose: Manual ETF/public-fund-to-class construction, class allocation and strategy workflows, plus real-product evaluation plans that lock custom-indicator revisions and run strict-complete weighted rankings. Shared allocationJourney preserves browser input drafts and saved references by explicit universe/allocation/baseline scope, carries the product-pool-to-SAA-to-TAA navigation context and invalidates results after input or research-clock changes; a browser draft is not saved calculation or PIT evidence. AllocationMetricsReview gives ManualConstruction and ClassAllocation an opt-in core-metric view with annual detail and research charts expanded on demand, while the base comparison table keeps its existing full-row default. Active journey metadata is isolated per browser tab in sessionStorage, initially seeded from the latest local record; cross-tab storage events cannot replace navigation. Explicit universe changes clear old range metadata, and pool return links restore the named immutable universe rather than another selection draft.
blast_radius: ETF/public-fund evaluation filtering and target selection
minimum_regression: /bin/sh -c 'cd frontend && npm run test -- --run src/components/HorizontalMetricComparison.test.tsx src/app/allocationJourney.test.tsx src/layouts/StageLayout.test.tsx src/pages/ManualConstruction.test.tsx src/pages/ProductPoolSelection.test.tsx src/pages/ProductPools.test.tsx src/pages/ClassAllocation.test.tsx src/pages/PortfolioConstruction.test.tsx'
